__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A long, slender whip lies here.
__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: comet's tail

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: Arm plates of the Zodiac lie here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: These mighty armors have been worn by this immortal, since the ancient time.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: arm hercules
__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.short_descr: the Titanic Arm plates of Hercules

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A belt of the Zodiac lies here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
You can immediately see that it belongs to Orion, from the three stars
engraved on it.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: belt orion

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A massive skull of a dead Draco lies here.
__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: skull draco

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A fleece of the Zodiac lies here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: From a look it resembles the Golden Fleece that exists in the Greek myths.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: fleece aries

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A hoof of the Zodiac lies here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: It is with these hooves that Taurus can stand against Orion's attacks.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: hoof taurus

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A mask of the Zodiac lies here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
You notice the mask has got two faces, one smiling and the other crying.
You don't know which way you should wear it.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: mask gemini

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A shell of the Zodiac lies here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
A shell which is dented in the middle, resulting from the Hercules' mighty
pound when the Crab was still an enemy of Hercules in ancient times.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: shell cancer

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A skin of the Zodiac lies here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: A skin made of metal, which was worn by Hercules during his Ten Labours.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: skin leo

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A bracelet of the Zodiac lies here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: A bracelet of purity and youth, only worn by selected virgins.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: bracelet virgo

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A shield of the Zodiac lies here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: It is a shield of justice, used in the ancient battle against injustice.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: scale libra

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A shield of the Zodiac lies here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: It is a shield of injustice, it picks on the innocent.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: scale libra

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: Sting of the Zodiac lies here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: This dreadful weapon put a lot of mortals to death before Scorpio was banished.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: sting scorpio

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: The Arrow of Sagittarius lies here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: It's an arrow of lightning; it will never miss any target.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: arrow sagittarius

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: The Titanic Bow of Sagittarius lies here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: The gigantic bow used by the Archer; it is a very powerful weapon.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: bow sagittarius

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A pair of horns of the Zodiac lies here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
These strange horns are the work of gods, shaped to fit on hands.
They look powerful indeed.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: horns capricon

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A vessel of the Zodiac lies here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
This vessel has been carried by the Water Bearer ever since she came to the
Zodiac.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: vessel aquarius

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A fish tail of the Zodiac lies here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
This tail can actually be worn by mortals somehow as leggings ... another
work of the gods.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: tail pisces

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A ring of specialty lies here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
This ring belongs to Cassiopeia, queen of the Universe.
Mortals, do not touch!

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: ring dignity

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A sceptre of interest lies here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: You'd better give it back, or the king of the Universe will punish you.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: sceptre might

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: Here lies a fortune ... a small ring of power.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: It conceals the power of the universe.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: ring universe

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A dazzling white object lies on the ground.
__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: great dipper
__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.short_descr: the Great Dipper of the Skies

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A shoot grows here, covered with dew.
__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: spring shoot

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A flower grows here, waiting to be picked up.
__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: summer flower

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A leaf lies here, as if just fallen from a tree.
__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: autumn leaf

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A branch lies here, still covered with snow.
__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: winter branch

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: Some chains lie on the floor.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: They certainly look important!

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: chains andromeda
